farplanetwocontinuation.options.title: Far Plane Settings
Turns the distant and detailed terrain on and off in all dimensions. The mod must also be installed on the server (in singleplayer the vanilla integrated server is used).
farplanetwocontinuation.options.force_lo: Shows the LOD terrain even when shaders are on.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.distance: How far the distant terrain is drawn. Maximum - the edge of the world.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.start.to: Size of the distant terrain cells right after the detailed terrain (or after vanilla chunks when it is off). Farther away the cells grow on their own. The smaller the cells, the more detailed the terrain, but the CPU load grows.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.sharpnes: How sharp the terrain looks far away. Adapts to the screen resolution and field of view. The higher, the sharper the picture, but the CPU load is higher and more video memory is used.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.memory.t: How much video memory is given to the distant terrain. The more, the sharper it is. Lowering it is recommended on weak devices.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.fog.tool: How far from the player the fog haze starts. The higher, the farther. At 100% there is almost no haze, and the solid fog starts sharply
farplanetwocontinuation.options.fog_mode: If some mod controls the fog, that fog goes on over the distant terrain too. If there is no such mod or it is inactive, vanilla fog is dropped and FarPlaneTwo fog is drawn.
Turns off vanilla fog and the fog of other mods and draws its own.
Control of the fog goes to another mod or the game and continues over the LOD terrain. FarPlaneTwo fog is turned off.
Turns off all fog on the surface. To turn off underwater fog, open the matching tab.
Radius where the solid fog starts. The radius where the haze starts is set with the 'Fog Start' slider
farplanetwocontinuation.options.fog_shap: Cylinder - from high up the surface is seen better. Sphere - with height the terrain hides behind the fog (as in vanilla)
farplanetwocontinuation.options.water_fo: Turns fog under water on and off. When on, the fog continues vanilla's or another mod's fog, so the two blend in
farplanetwocontinuation.options.cloud_fa: Fixes the vanilla bug where clouds are cut off at high altitude. Off by default to lower the risk of conflicts with mods that change clouds
farplanetwocontinuation.options.new_rend: Turns on the optimized and more exact renderer. Does not work with shaders.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.high_ent: Fixes the vanilla bug where the player model turns dark at high altitude.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.smoothin: How much the borders between two areas on the distant terrain are smoothed (when off, borders are 'stairs')
farplanetwocontinuation.options.blur.too: How much the border between two neighbouring areas on the distant terrain is blurred
farplanetwocontinuation.options.blur.val: How smoothly one color turns into the other at the border between two areas. When off, a sharp line is drawn
farplanetwocontinuation.options.smoothin: The higher, the smoother the coasts. Sharp points, squares and bumps are smoothed out. But small bays or bits of land may disappear.
The higher, the smoother the snow line, but small patches of snow and thawed ground may disappear.
The higher, the smoother the forest edges, but small clearings and groves may disappear.
The higher, the smoother the biome borders, but small patches of another biome may disappear.
The higher, the smoother the borders between water of different temperatures.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.clear_ca: Clear LOD Cache of This Dimension...
Clear the LOD cache of this dimension?
Distant and detailed terrain of the dimension you are in will be loaded again, other dimensions keep their cache. In singleplayer the cache files of this dimension are deleted and created again.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.detailed: Shows terrain almost identical to normal chunks around the vanilla render distance. Uses Level-of-detail optimization (simplifying distant objects) to save resources.

Turns on generating the detailed terrain (virtual chunks) from scratch. Even where nobody has been yet, light virtual chunks (detailed terrain) are generated from scratch. On the surface they look almost like vanilla ones. Nothing is generated underground
Render radius of the detailed terrain. Beyond this radius the usual distant terrain is drawn. Larger values need more memory and loading time.

How the blocks of the detailed terrain look. Off: 1x1 textures, vanilla colors. Low: blurred textures, thin blocks (snow, leaf litter, slabs), translucent water. Medium: vanilla textures. High: leaves with gaps. Ultra: grass, flowers, sugar cane, underwater plants, simplified lighting. The higher, the more load on the video card.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.load_spe: How many resources go to generating the detailed terrain, depending on how fast the player moves. Auto: loads slowly while walking, but FPS is steadier. Generates faster while flying, at the cost of lower FPS. Smooth: always low priority. Fast: always as fast as possible.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.detailed: Video memory for the detailed terrain. The more, the more correct the blocks far away. Lowering it is recommended on weak devices.
How deep from the surface (in blocks) the server scans the terrain. Large values can load the CPU
Brings back ore vein generation in virtual chunks. Loads the CPU a little and makes more 'garbage' in memory

farplanetwocontinuation.help.title: FarPlaneTwoContinuation commands:
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen: /farplane pregen detail start <radius> - generate the detailed terrain within <radius> chunks (1-256) around you ahead of time
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_at: ... start <radius> <x> <z> - the same around the block column x z
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_stat: /farplane pregen detail|distant status - progress and time left
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_stop: /farplane pregen detail|distant stop - stop, what is done stays saved
farplanetwocontinuation.help.operators: The /farplane commands are for operators (in singleplayer: with cheats allowed).
farplanetwocontinuation.help.keys: Keys: F7 - LOD terrain on/off, F8 - settings, F3 + O - clear the LOD cache of this dimension. They can be changed in Controls.
